description: This source file contains an extension for the ChannelsSettings class, providing various private helper functions, computed properties, and methods to manage channel statuses, generate UI elements, and summarize channel information for a messaging application interface.

methods.name: channelStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes the status snapshot for a specific channel by ID.

methods.name: configuredChannelTint
methods.description: Determines the tint color for a channel based on its configuration and connection status.

methods.name: configuredChannelSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary string indicating if the channel is configured or running.

methods.name: appendProbeDetails
methods.description: Appends detailed status information about a probe to a list of strings.

methods.name: finishDetails
methods.description: Finalizes and joins lines of status details into a single string.

methods.name: finishProbeDetails
methods.description: Wraps up probe status details into a consolidated string.

methods.name: channelSection
methods.description: Returns a SwiftUI view representing a channel's section in the UI.

methods.name: channelTint
methods.description: Determines the UI tint color for a specific channel item.

methods.name: channelSummary
methods.description: Provides a textual summary of the channel's current state.

methods.name: channelDetails
methods.description: Returns detailed string information about a specific channel.

methods.name: channelLastCheckText
methods.description: Returns a relative age string for the last check timestamp of a channel.

methods.name: channelLastCheck
methods.description: Returns the last check date for a specific channel.

methods.name: channelHasError
methods.description: Determines if the current status of a channel indicates an error.

methods.name: resolveChannelTitle
methods.description: Resolves the display title for a channel ID, fallback to capitalized ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailTitle
methods.description: Resolves detailed label for a channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves the system image name associated with a channel ID.

methods.name: channelStatusDictionary
methods.description: Fetches the raw dictionary of status data for a channel.
